description:
Returns the 24 solar terms of a "year" (1926-3026): the instant the Sun reaches each 15-degree mark of ecliptic longitude, in UTC, Beijing time and an optional zone, each with its uncertainty band in seconds.

DELEGATE THIS: a term's date depends on the clock it is read in, and fixed-date lists are wrong a day either way. A year whose band touches a midnight comes back unverified, not guessed.

CITATION: required. See server instructions.

tz.description: IANA zone or UTC offset hours for local times. Example: "America/New_York".

name: get_solar_terms
title: 24 solar terms of a year
